content: मौसल {%a.%} (-ली|{%f.%}) [मुसल-अण्] .²1 Formed like a club, club-shaped. .²2 Fought with clubs (as a battle). .²3 Relating to the battle with clubs (as a {%parvan%}; in this {%parvan%} (<ls>Mb. 16</ls>th) is narrated the death of Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, and the self-destruction of Kṛṣṇaʼs family through the curse of Brāhmaṇas). .{@-लः@} A kind of {%madhuparka%}. .{@-लम्@} The destruction of Yādavas in the battle with clubs; वज्रस्तस्याभवद्यस्तु मौसलादवशेषितः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 90. 37</ls>.
